title: Was there last night
content: I was at the smaller mall that I go to last night - only one level! The layout seems to be a circle with various types of stores, including a drug store, and a store that sells mostly purses. I bought ice cream from a clothing store. It was delicious. The mall was decently busy last night. Was anyone at my smaller mall last night?? And does anyone else have a huge extravagant multi level mall with the big escalator to the upper level food court, stores and theatres - and this smaller more humble mall? Just found this group and love it.
